theorems.name: Submission.aal_dge1_density_le_monotone_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (x : Amb n ℓ) (ω R A β θ₀ : ℝ) (F : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < ω → 0 < R → 0 < β → 0 ≤ θ₀ → (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t ≤ R → |F t - 1| ≤ A * (t / R) ^ β) → (∀ s t : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ t → t ≤ R → F s * ((μ (closedBall x s)).toReal / s ^ n) + (F s - 1) ≤ F t * ((μ (closedBall x t)).toReal / t ^ n) + (F t - 1)) → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => μ (closedBall x r) / ENNReal.ofReal (ω * r ^ n)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (ENNReal.ofReal θ₀)) → ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t ≤ R → ω * θ₀ ≤ (1 + A * (t / R) ^ β) * ((μ (closedBall x t)).toReal / t ^ n) + A * (t / R) ^ β
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
